## Machine Learning Engineer

[SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE - not a real vacancy]

Fernway Labs is hiring a Machine Learning Engineer to join our risk modeling team. Location: Austin, TX. This is an on-site role.

## Responsibilities
* Train, evaluate and ship classification models for credit risk and fraud detection
* Own feature engineering and experiment tracking with MLflow
* Build batch inference pipelines in Python and SQL
* Partner with product and compliance stakeholders to validate model behavior
* Monitor deployed models for drift and data quality issues

## Minimum Qualifications
* MS or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Machine Learning, or a related field
* 2+ years of experience developing machine learning models
* Proficiency in Python, scikit-learn, and pandas
* Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow
* Solid understanding of model evaluation, statistics, and feature engineering

## Preferred Qualifications
* Experience with Kubernetes and Docker
* Experience with Apache Spark
* Background in financial services or banking
* Experience with NLP or text classification

Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to sponsor visas for this position.
